title: Accurate in space, unreliable in time: how LLMs represent national cultural change
reasoning: The paper evaluates how well LLMs capture national cultural changes over time using data from the World Values Survey. The evaluated dimensions include 'traditional vs. secular-rational values', which explicitly measure importance placed on religion, religious faith, and moral judgments like the justifiability of abortion and homosexuality. Thus, it contains a significant component of evaluating religious representation and societal moral values in LLMs.
